scientific_goal: Establish unified VOS framework deriving Nesterov's accelerated method and ADMM from continuous-time dynamical systems, proving linear convergence via Lyapunov functions

nesterov_accelerated_gradient.description: First-order method with momentum achieving O(1/k²) convergence for convex L-smooth functions
nesterov_accelerated_gradient.convergence_rate: O(1/k²) for convex functions, linear for strongly convex

admm.description: Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers for composite optimization with splitting
key_equations: dual update: y^{k+1} = y^k + ρ(Ax^{k+1} + Bz^{k+1} - c)
admm.convergence_rate: O(1/k) for general convex, linear under strong convexity

vos_framework.description: Unified view via continuous-time dynamical systems and Lyapunov analysis
vos_framework.lyapunov_function: Energy-based Lyapunov for stability and convergence proof
